# Peerbits

> > Peerbits is a software development and digital transformation company offering custom development, cloud services, AI solutions, and dedicated developer hiring across mobile, web, and enterprise technologies.

Peerbits specializes in offshore software development with 180+ pre-vetted Indian developers available for hire by USA-based companies. The company provides end-to-end services from product engineering and digital transformation to cloud infrastructure and AI development, with expertise in modern tech stacks including AWS, DevOps, React, Flutter, and generative AI.

- [Software Development Services](https://www.peerbits.com/software-development.html): Custom software development, SaaS, web, MVP, and enterprise solutions.

- [Product Engineering Services](https://www.peerbits.com/product-engineering-services.html): Product engineering with strategy, design, delivery, AWS, and CI/CD.
